invariants.statement: apps/web must remain absent from the repository.
A selected bundle must use an immutable release tag, exact HTTPS URL, and SHA-256 digest.
Signature, provenance, rollback, capability-denial, network-destination, visual, and existing-profile migration evidence must pass before selection.
Seventwos UI, product, auth, storage, profile migration, configuration, and release paths require repository ownership review.
Upstream assessment automation may report candidates but may not apply changes, merge, publish, or update bundle selection.
Existing upstream ledger entries may not be edited, reordered, or removed.
